title: Configure Firewall Rules (UFW)
objective: Allow HTTP and HTTPS traffic through the host firewall.
rationale: Ubuntu 24.04 uses UFW; without explicit rules, incoming port 80/443 connections will be blocked by default.
expected_output: Confirmation messages showing rules added (e.g., 'Allow OpenSSH' is already enabled, 'Allow HTTP', 'Allow HTTPS').
success_criteria: UFW status lists port 80 and 443 as ALLOW.
